results.content:
Saasaa3

  Never knew how much I needed this app till I began using it, the transcription accuracy is almost perfect but that’s expected as audio can vary. The time it takes to get thru an hour long audio clip is quite fast too, a slight downside was I couldn’t download the audio but when I reached out to the developer, they were quick to implement the feature! The interface is simple too which I prefer as I can just get right to business. Another change that would be a great add on is making the past transcripts stay as transcripts and not reverting back to audio. Other than this, this is an app is a time saver when doing projects and I totally recommend it.

  Developer Response

  Thank you for the thumbs up! :)

  peredayzaproyizd

  Very high accuracy, even in other languages which are not English (I did mine in Ukrainian), very simple to use and very quick! Also I love that I can translate my audio, I also did it, haven’t really checked how it came up yet but from the first few lines it looks very good! Love it, I did it all with the free trial. Also the sad moment is that the audio can be no more than 60 minutes, but it is not really the problem because I just cut my audio into pieces and transcribed and translated all them separately.

  Developer Response

  We wish we could make it free but server side transcription is expensive!
 ### Useful Utility for Voice to Text Transcription

  Recent Spiiker [...] Spiik helps me transcribe audio recordings of meeting captured using my iPhone’s Voice Memo App. Spiik has cool AI features such as Paraphrase, Highlights, Structured notes, etc which I have used to extract meeting minutes and summaries. While the built-in AI capabilities of Spiik are useful, there is clearly room for improvement and I hope and expect the developer, Rony is provided an opportunity to make incremental improvements that will benefit end users and increase the number of people who use Spiik. What captured my interest in this app was the app icon. Another aspect that impressed me tremendously was that Rony was very responsive to my need for bug-fix support. Thank you Rony for fixing the problem I was having which allowed me to get the transcription results I expected.
